changelog:
COURIER (v8.1.1) - A patch for a defect introduced in 8.1.0, plus the test change that would have caught it.
- [FIX] The public landing page named a variable it never defined. When 8.1.0 moved the source label and the resonance count into the shared render layer, index.php was made to pass a local-URL variable that page has never had - its visitor is not the operator, so there is nothing about "me" to ask. PHP answers an undefined variable with null, the count still came out right, every test passed, and the only thing that noticed was the production error log, which received a line on every single view. relay_resonance_count() now exists so the question the page actually asks is expressible without inventing an answer.
- [FIX] The smoke suite could not have caught it, and that is the more important half of this release. It loaded every entry point against an empty database, so each page queried a table that did not exist, received nothing, and skipped the loop that renders a transmission - which is exactly where the bug lived. It reported thirteen clean loads while knowing nothing about the code path that was broken. The sandbox is now built from installer/schema.sql and seeded with one local and one incoming signal, so both halves of every render branch are reachable. installer/schema.sql is read rather than copied, so the test cannot drift away from the real shape.
- [FIX] The smoke suite now fails on reads of undefined things, not only on fatals. Undefined variable, undefined array key, undefined property and array-offset-on-null are treated as failures. A fatal says "this endpoint is broken"; an undefined read says "this code is lying about what it knows", and only the first was being checked.
- [VERIFIED] The check was pointed at the shipped 8.1.0 index.php and reports "Undefined variable" for it, then passes on the corrected one. Both directions were run, so the guard is known to work rather than merely green.
- [NOTE] Two assertions added to tests/render_test.php, bringing the suite to 280 passing. No behaviour changes beyond the fix above; 8.1.0's store-and-forward outbox, server-side self-resonance rule and shared render layer are unchanged and still verified.
- [NOTE] If you are running 8.1.0, this replaces it. The outbox migration from 8.1.0 is unchanged and does not need re-running.
